summary: ECARX Holdings furnished a 6-K confirming completion of its acquisition of 100% of Hubei Qiguang Technology, the DreamSmart-carved entity holding the Flyme Auto cockpit OS and Flyme OS, first announced June 22, 2026 and closed October 5, 2026. Total cash consideration was RMB1.8 billion (~US$266 million) versus an independent valuation of RMB1.824 billion at May 31, 2026. Funding is roughly 70% syndicated Chinese bank loans (10-year maturity) and 30% internal sources, plus a RMB200 million post-closing capital injection. Flyme operates as an independent software division. Watch integration execution, leverage added by the 10-year debt, and any dilution-related follow-on financing.
